scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run test:e2e:indirect && pnpm run test:e2e:direct && pnpm run test:e2e:proxy && pnpm run test:e2e:manager && pnpm run test:e2e:starters && pnpm run test:e2e:sso && pnpm run test:e2e:sso:https && pnpm run test:e2e:sso:app-owned
scripts.test:e2e:direct: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR playwright test --config playwright.direct.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:sso: pnpm --filter @magic-link-sso/core build && pnpm --filter @magic-link-sso/nextjs build && env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR playwright test --config playwright.sso.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:headed: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR playwright test --config playwright.indirect.config.ts --headed
scripts.test:e2e:indirect: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR playwright test --config playwright.indirect.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:manager: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR playwright test --config playwright.manager.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:ui: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR PW_SLOWMO_MS=${PW_SLOWMO_MS:-700} playwright test --config playwright.indirect.config.ts --ui
scripts.test:e2e:proxy: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR playwright test --config playwright.proxy.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:starters: MAGICSSO_STARTER_PATH=gate playwright test --config playwright.starters.config.ts && MAGICSSO_STARTER_PATH=sdk playwright test --config playwright.starters.config.ts
